user.title: Lutron Pico fallback bridge
user.description: Needs the MQTT integration, Zigbee2MQTT, and the lutbridge-esp32 bridge paired with it (firmware, wiring and pairing: https://github.com/davemhammer/lutbridge-esp32).

init.title: Review the fallback changes

error.apply_failed: The changes could not be applied; see the message above and the Heartbeat/Plan sensors.

board_not_found.title: Pico bridge not found
board_not_found.description: {detail} The bridge firmware, wiring and pairing instructions are at https://github.com/davemhammer/lutbridge-esp32

converter.title: Pico bridge converter is out of date

drift.title: Pico mapping is out of date

on_fallback.title: Picos are running on the fallback

firmware.title: Pico bridge firmware is out of date

plan.name: Make plan
plan.description: Work out which Zigbee lights each Pico should control and what must change, and show it for approval.

rewrite_slots.name: Rewrite all slots
rewrite_slots.description: Ignore what was remembered about the board's slots and clear and rewrite every one. Use after reflashing or erasing the board.

apply.name: Apply plan
apply.description: Apply the plan that was last shown. Refuses if the system changed since it was made.

plan_id.name: Plan id
plan_id.description: The id shown with the plan. Optional; if given it must match the plan that was shown.

install_converter.name: Install converter
install_converter.description: Send the bundled Zigbee2MQTT converter for the pico bridge to Zigbee2MQTT over MQTT.
